# Partner Facts: Google Cloud (GCP)
last-verified: 2026-01 (from training knowledge — TREAT AS STALE, verify before publish)
staleness-warning: NOT web-verified. Google renames and reorganizes Vertex/Gemini
  offerings frequently. Persona must recommend verifying current names and must not
  assert an uncertain one.

## Agent stack (verify all before use)
- Vertex AI — the ML/GenAI platform umbrella.
- Vertex AI Agent Builder — build/deploy agents and search/conversation experiences.
- Agent Development Kit (ADK) — open-source framework for building agents.
- Agent Engine (Vertex) — managed runtime for deploying agents (confirm current name).
- Agent2Agent (A2A) — open protocol for agent interoperability (Google-initiated).
- Gemini — foundation model family.
- Gemini Enterprise — enterprise agent/assistant surface (verify current branding).

## Platform
- Vertex AI Model Garden — model catalog.
- BigQuery — data warehouse, often the data spine for agent grounding.

## Naming traps to catch in drafts
- "Vertex AI Agent Builder" vs "Agent Engine" vs "ADK" — distinct things; don't conflate.
- Gemini model version names change fast — verify the specific version cited.

## Positioning the Google field team endorses
- Open standards / interoperability (A2A, MCP support).
- Data-to-AI story: BigQuery grounding, data gravity.
- Multimodal Gemini strength.
